AI.title: Discover and inventory AI workloads
AI.description: Inventory all AI/ML models and endpoints including Azure OpenAI.
AI.kqlQuery:
arg("").resources
| where type in~ ("Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts","Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces")
| extend kind = tostring(properties.kind)
| project name, type, kind, location, resourceGroup, subscriptionId
| order by type asc
AI.remediation: Run the Resource Graph query to inventory all Cognitive Services and ML workspaces. Tag each with owner, purpose, and data classification.

setup: No setup required — runs against any Azure subscription

AI.title: Protect AI models and data pipelines
AI.description: Secure AI training data with encryption, access controls, and network isolation.
AI.kqlQuery:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES"
| where ResultType != "Success"
| summarize FailedCalls = count() by Resource, OperationName
| where FailedCalls > 10
| order by FailedCalls desc
| take 50
AI.remediation: Enable network isolation for Cognitive Services. Configure private endpoints and disable public network access for all AI service instances.

setup: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on a Log Analytics workspace
Cognitive Services resource → Diagnostic settings → Send to Sentinel workspace
Enable all log categories (RequestResponse)
AI telemetry flows into Analytics tier and is mirrored to the Data Lake tier

AI.title: Implement responsible AI practices
AI.description: Deploy content filters and monitor for harmful or biased AI outputs.
AI.kqlQuery:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES"
| where OperationName has "ContentSafety"
| summarize FilteredRequests = count() by Resource, OperationName
| order by FilteredRequests desc
| take 50
AI.remediation: Enable content filters in Azure OpenAI Studio. Configure severity thresholds for hate, sexual, violence, and self-harm categories. Monitor filtered requests.
